ops.title: P7 curated-reference deferral: splice/matcher internals stay private for v14
ops.body:
Orchestrator-adjudicated during the P7 docs pass (cc-task 0bb5d04b): the curated great-docs reference gains `Occurrence` (Command lines section, so the 13.2.0 splice surface renders beside Command/CommandLine) and the root-exported `Fidelity` (Context windows section), and drops the dead `cli:` block (module `cc_transcript.cli` deleted in P5). Deliberately NOT curated for v14 — private surface: `SpecMatcher`, `keep_events`, `label_events`, `embedded_literals`. Revisit if any of the four graduates to the public API.

Related finding, reported not fixed (docs lane had a no-code-edits mandate): `scripts/gen_command_golden.py`'s module docstring still narrates the pre-flip world ("Freeze the Python CommandLine structure", "tests/test_command_parity.py asserts the Rust port reproduces") — post-P6 the script would freeze native output, and the Python reference it names is deleted.
